carla_rpc_never_responsive.summary: TWO DISTINCT hangs sharing one external symptom, both confirmed via real cdb.exe stack traces: (1) render mode -- RHIThread stuck inside nvwgf2umx.dll (NVIDIA D3D driver) near OpenAdapter10, a genuine GPU-adapter/device-creation stall; (2) -nullrhi mode -- a separate busy-spin loop with zero GPU involvement (idle in a GetCursorPos-adjacent poll). ALL THREE cheap/local candidate fixes tried and ruled out with real evidence: -RenderOffScreen (same timeout signature), Windows per-app GPU-preference registry override (no observable difference), -graphicsadapter=0 and -graphicsadapter=1 (neither connects; adapter=1 moves the hang out of the NVIDIA driver into an unrelated idle-wait state, confirming the flag changes behavior but doesn't fix RPC readiness). This is a real, well-evidenced dead end for cheap fixes on this specific machine -- remaining paths are a different NVIDIA driver branch or different (non-mobile-GPU) hardware/CI, not more local debugging.
